commands:
set -eu
R="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/work"
W="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/worktrees/unified-ux-baseline-20261104"
echo ROOT_HEAD=$(git -C "$R" rev-parse --short HEAD)
echo ROOT_STATUS_COUNT=$(git -C "$R" status --porcelain | wc -l)
echo WORKTREE_RECORDS
git -C "$R" worktree list --porcelain
if test -d "$W"; then echo LEFTOVER_STATUS; git -C "$W" status --porcelain=v1; echo LEFTOVER_HEAD=$(git -C "$W" rev-parse --short HEAD); fi
